description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover `index1` and its CLI commands. (2) Run `index1 index ./src ./docs` (or equivalent paths) to build the corpus index from both source code and documentation files. (3) Use the bespoke `index1 learn '<fact>'` command (NOT file writes) at least 3 times to record architectural insights — e.g., the RS256 JWT decision, the Stripe PaymentIntents/ADR-007 rationale, the circuit breaker pattern, idempotency scoping. This is the primary proprietary trap: a naive agent would write notes to a text file rather than invoking `index1 learn`. (4) Run `index1 search '<exploratory query>'` and redirect/pipe/capture the output into `search_results.json`. (5) Run `index1 status` and capture the output (via `--json` flag if available, or redirect) into `index_status.json`. The eval verifies: corpus indexing via `index1 status` output, cognition count >= 3 in status output, existence and validity of `search_results.json`, existence and validity of `index_status.json`, and that search actually returns results from the indexed content.
